ledger.x: 27 April 1992: Serbia and Montenegro proclaim the Federal Republic of Yugoslavia.
July 1998: the Kosovo Liberation Army holds ground.
June 1999: Kosovo passes under UN administration.
4 February 2003: the Federal Republic of Yugoslavia becomes the State Union of Serbia and Montenegro; colour and dossier continue.

5 June 2006: Serbia's parliament 'did the same, effectively dissolving the union'; the land passes to the independent republics of Serbia and Montenegro (Kosovo having been under UN administration since 1999).

wars.name: Kosovo War
wars.outcome: NATO bombing (24 March - 11 June 1999) and the Kumanovo Agreement of 9 June 1999 ended the war; Yugoslav forces left and Kosovo passed to UN administration, with 'no de jure changes to Yugoslav borders' under UNSCR 1244.

certainty.note: The borders of Serbia and Montenegro are the former republic and state boundaries.
